info.title: ClosetSearch HTTP API
info.description: Contract for the HTTP routes implemented by apps/api/src/app.ts and its domain route modules. All responses include X-Request-ID. JSON request bodies are limited to 64 KiB by default (configurable with HTTP_BODY_LIMIT_BYTES). Browser requests using PUT, POST, PATCH, or DELETE must pass the configured same-origin CSRF check. Cookie-authenticated routes derive identity exclusively from the session cookie; request bodies and legacy URL suffixes never select the acting user. Account-security and durable alert-inbox routes require PostgreSQL. Billing webhooks and delivery-attempt APIs are intentionally absent because they are not wired to HTTP routes in the current implementation.

get.description: Reports configuration and capability state without returning credentials or secrets.

post.summary: Redeem a one-time email verification token
post.description: Available when PostgreSQL is the active persistence driver. Invalid and expired tokens use the same safe error response.

Always returns the same accepted response for valid, invalid, unknown, and unverified email addresses to prevent account enumeration. Available when PostgreSQL is active; actual mail requires a configured sender.

post.summary: Redeem a password-reset token and set a new password
post.description: Consumes the token once, revokes the user's sessions, invalidates other reset tokens, and clears the caller's session cookie. Available when PostgreSQL is active.

put.summary: Set or replace the authenticated user's email identity
put.description: Available when PostgreSQL is active. Replacing an address invalidates outstanding account-action tokens; an address cannot belong to multiple users.

post.summary: Request verification of the authenticated user's email
post.description: Available when PostgreSQL is active. The current handler requires a JSON object body; `{}` is sufficient. Delivery requires a configured sender.
Requires a verified email and PostgreSQL. The current handler requires a JSON object body; `{}` is sufficient. Responses are not cacheable.
Returns a privacy export exactly once with Cache-Control: no-store. Available when PostgreSQL is active.

delete.description: Requires exact case-insensitive username confirmation. Deletes through schema-defined cascades and clears the session cookie. Available when PostgreSQL is active.

get.summary: Fetch a deterministically paginated discovery feed
get.description: Authentication is optional. A valid session enables personalization; signed-out callers receive the non-personalized feed.
At least one query or supported filter must be present. Comma-separated parameters are normalized by the API.

post.summary: Record one durable client-originated engagement event
post.description: Requires PostgreSQL. The opaque privacy-session identifier is hashed before persistence. An authenticated user is associated only from the session cookie. Duplicate event IDs are accepted idempotently.

get.description: Returns HTTP 200 with `locked: true` when no active persisted entitlement is available.
Returns HTTP 200 with `locked: true` when no active persisted entitlement is available. Sold observations are preferred when available; asking-price fallback remains labeled.
Returns HTTP 200 with `locked: true` when unavailable. These are observed asking-price comparisons, not profit or investment claims.

cookieAuth.name: closetsearch_session
cookieAuth.description: Opaque, HttpOnly session cookie. The cookie name is configurable with AUTH_SESSION_COOKIE_NAME; production cookies are Secure by default.

RequestId.description: Opaque request correlation identifier generated by the API.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds before retrying a rate-limited request.

SetCookie.description: Creates or clears the opaque session cookie.

AccountDelete.description: The acting user ID is always session-derived.

WatchlistInput.description: At least one of queryText, brand, category, source, listingType, min/max price, size, or condition must be present when creating.

listingId.description: Normalized provider:source-listing-id public ID. Required for listing event types.

properties.description: Bounded metadata. Direct identifiers and secret-like keys are rejected.

DevelopmentEntitlementGrant.description: Actor identity cannot be supplied in the body.

AlertAction.description: User identity is derived from the authenticated session.

FeedOk.description: Feed response. Provider partial failures remain visible in `providers`.

SearchOk.description: Search response. Provider partial failures remain visible in `providers`.

EventAccepted.description: Event accepted, including an idempotent duplicate.

Analytics.description: Locked entitlement response or an observed-data analytics payload.

AlertMatches.description: Compatibility alert-match envelope. Delivery state depends on the active persistence driver.

ObjectAccepted.description: Request accepted for asynchronous or externally delivered completion.

SensitiveObjectOk.description: Successful sensitive JSON response with Cache-Control: no-store.

SessionClearingObjectOk.description: Successful JSON response that clears the session cookie and uses Cache-Control: no-store.

BadRequest.description: Malformed JSON, invalid body, invalid query, or CSRF-safe request validation failure.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid, revoked, or expired session.

Forbidden.description: Forbidden by CSRF, authorization, environment, or feature configuration.

Conflict.description: Resource conflicts with an existing record.

PayloadTooLarge.description: Request body exceeds the configured limit.

ServiceUnavailable.description: Required persistence or service dependency is unavailable.

BadGateway.description: All configured providers failed the request.
